current_behavior:
ENGINE. A ticket row is minted once per booking by Ticket::issue() (ticket.php:699-727): ticket_number + signed pipe payload `SHG-TICKET|PNR|date|seats|from->to|phone|ticketNo|n|dep_time|bus_number|sig` (:35-62; dep_time = COALESCE(s.dep_time_override, r.dep_time) and bus_number come from loadBooking :1533-1560). Ticket::reissue($id, $countRevision=true) (:748-795) re-mints qr_payload/qr_hash with the SAME ticket_number, nulls pdf_path/png_path/invoice_path, unlinks tickets/ticket_PNR.{pdf,png} + invoice, bumps reissue_count/reissued_at (unless $countRevision=false) and writes audit `ticket.reissue`. pngPath/pdfPath (:802-914) call issue() (idempotent), serve the cached file when the column is non-empty, the file exists and its mtime is newer than PNG/PDF_LAYOUT_CHANGED (:1654/:1660), else render under a sibling .lock (renderWithLock :1504-1527; .lock files are never removed). The PNG prints CORRECTED TICKET · REV n (markText :1743-1754), a DEP time + bus strip (:1262-1265) and a PAID/PAYMENT DUE pill from the latest payments row (:1154, :1429). IMPORTANT NUANCE: the PNG's QR is the keyed verify URL `verify-ticket.php?pnr&k=downloadToken(pnr)` (:1402, token = HMAC of PNR only :411-414) — it NEVER changes on a correction; only the PDF prints the signed pipe payload (:1972). Both validate through verifyQrPayload (:360-396) and the gate reads live DB state, so a stale picture still scans "valid" — the REV banner is the only visual cue. Public links: downloadUrl (PDF), imageUrl (PNG, adds `&r=<reissue_count>` only when >0, memoised per request in a static array :441-466); download-ticket.php ignores r, refuses non-confirmed bookings (:51), and Response::download sends `Cache-Control: private, max-age=0, must-revalidate` with no ETag/Last-Modified (response.php:194; verified locally — 188,934-byte PNG, fresh fetch each time), inline `private, no-cache` (:214). Live: /tickets/*.png → nginx 404 (conf:111), keyless download → 302 to #/my, verify-ticket → no-store. sw.js: only `/download-ticket.php?img=` is cached (TICKET_CACHE, max 10, key strips k AND r :145-158), network-first with a 4 s race (:39, :200-220); PDF/invoice/admin/api are passthrough (:229-233); the SPA's share/download fall back to a client canvas drawn from localStorage when the server PNG fetch fails (11-pdf-ticket.js:360-382, 07-checkout.js:1590-1602). Audit: Logger::audit(action, entity, id, old, new, detail, reason='') fills actor_type/id/name/role from the admin or user session, 'system' for webhook/AI paths (logger.php:143-196); `reason` is only populated when a caller passes the 7th arg.

STALE-CACHE RISKS: same filename ticket_<PNR>.png/.pdf reused forever; invalidation = unlink + null column; URL only changes via ?r when reissue_count>0 (not for settleCod, atSale attribution, layout re-render); imageUrl's per-request memo returns the OLD ?r if reissue happens later in the same request (an AI turn calling a lookup tool :871 then fix_ticket :1633); reissue inside Database::transaction (retry ×3 on deadlock db.php:282) can bump REV twice and deletes files even if the txn rolls back (self-heals); SW returns the saved copy when a cold re-render exceeds 4 s or offline; client canvas fallback draws pre-edit localStorage data; PDF liveStatus pill is time-dependent yet cached; .lock files accumulate. pay.php, api/payment.php, api/split-pay.php, seatversion.php never touch tickets.

gaps.title: Every 'ticket changed' WhatsApp and the manual Resend are silently swallowed by the purpose=ticket idempotency guard once the first ticket was 'sent'
gaps.evidence: includes/notify.php:326-338 `if (($meta['purpose'] ?? '') === 'ticket' && $bookingId ...) { $prior = ... ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1; if ($prior['status'] === 'sent') { self::$journal[] = [... 'reason' => 'idempotent']; return true; } }` — ticketChanged() passes `['purpose' => 'ticket']` (notify.php:930-936) and resendTicketWhatsApp() too (:822). Reproduced locally (rolled back): with a prior sent row, Notify::ticketChanged($detail,'seat',…) returned {ok:true, detail:'Change notice (seat) sent…'}, wrote NO message_logs row, journal reason 'idempotent'. Make ticketChanged/resend return ok=false with detail 'suppressed (idempotent)' if the guard ever fires, so the audit row and flash stop claiming delivery.

already_satisfied: Ticket::reissue() re-mints qr_payload/qr_hash keeping ticket_number, nulls pdf/png/invoice columns, unlinks tickets/ticket_<PNR>.{pdf,png} + invoice, bumps reissue_count/reissued_at and audits 'ticket.reissue' (includes/ticket.php:748-795); covered by tests/ticket-png-test.php:74-98 and tests/reschedule-test.php:114-120.

The regenerated PNG/PDF print 'CORRECTED TICKET · REV n · <time> · REPLACES EARLIER COPIES' (ticket.php:1743-1754) and the office DUPLICATE COPY render never overwrites the passenger's file (:870-887).
Ticket::imageUrl() appends &r=<reissue_count> so WhatsApp/browsers fetch a new URL after a counted correction (ticket.php:441-466); download-ticket.php ignores it safely.

Reschedule, missed-bus, per-seat cancel, seat transfer (both entry points), booking-view passenger/contact/payment edits, agent reassignment, AI rename/fix_ticket and WhatsApp post-sale rename all DO call Ticket::reissue (booking.php:1452, :2587; seats.php:2441; booking-view.php:79, :466; agentwallet.php:1640; aitools.php:1495, :1633; wabooking.php:807) — the engine exists, it is the orchestration/notify layer that is inconsistent.
booking-view edits regenerate eagerly: bv_regen_ticket → reissue + pngPath(force) and report REV in the flash (admin/booking-view.php:71-88).
COD settlement drops the cached PNG and PDF so the PAID pill re-renders (booking.php:1893-1909) and tells the customer via booking.cod_settled (events.php:308, notify.php:2272-2290).

download-ticket.php enforces keyed access (3-tier, :56-90), refuses non-confirmed bookings (:51), rate-limits (:40); Response::download sends 'Cache-Control: private, max-age=0, must-revalidate' and inline 'private, no-cache' (response.php:194/:214) — verified locally on http://localhost:8951 and live (keyless → 302, /tickets/ → 404).

nginx denies /tickets/ and /invoice/ (deploy/nginx-shreehariglobal.in.conf:111-112, live 404 confirmed) and deploy.sh:88 excludes tickets/ from sync, so rendered files are only reachable through download-ticket.php.
sw.js caches ONLY the ticket PNG, network-first since 19 Sep (sw.js:174-220); PDF, invoice, verify page and admin are passthrough (:229-233, :289-294); verify-ticket.php sends no-store (:164-168).
Layout changes force a one-time re-render of every cached PNG/PDF via PNG_/PDF_LAYOUT_CHANGED stamps (ticket.php:813, :902); tests/ticket-cache-test.php covers both.
Concurrent renders are serialised by a per-file flock (renderWithLock :1504-1527) and Ticket::issue is tolerant of the UNIQUE(booking_id) race (confirm :1773-1790).

Every mutation path writes an audit_logs row with actor_type/actor_id/actor_name/actor_role captured automatically from the session (logger.php:143-196); desk reschedule, passenger edit, seat change and contact edit already pass the typed reason (booking.php:1461-1466; booking-view.php:338, :468, :764).

Post-commit EventBus fan-out (events.php:236-315) delivers confirm/cod/cancel/reject messages outside the transaction, and the change-notice wording exists for reschedule/missed_rebook/seat/passenger/contact (notify.php:868-920) — it only needs the guard fix (G1) to actually go out.
QuickTicket pre-renders the PNG at sale so the desk and Twilio never wait on a cold render (quickticket.php:1146).
open_questions: Owner intent for operational trip changes (G2): on a departure-time or bus change should EVERY passenger receive a re-issued ticket (REV n banner + WhatsApp), or only a delay notice with silent regeneration? The REV banner wording 'CORRECTED TICKET' may alarm passengers for an office-side bus swap.

Live message_logs cannot be inspected (no ssh/DB access): how many change notices since 21 Sep were swallowed by the idempotency guard (journal reason 'idempotent') — the local reproduction proves the mechanism, the live count is unknown.

Cold PNG render time on the VPS (GD + HarfBuzz shaping) vs the SW's 4 s TICKET_WAIT_MS — could not measure without ssh; if renders exceed 4 s on a busy box the SW serves the stale copy on first open after a correction.

Should cancellation/rejection void the ticket row (is_void=1) and purge the SW copy, or is 'download refused by status + verify page shows CANCELLED' the intended behaviour? Today is_void is a dead column.
